title.en: A shift in the emergency department

tagline.zh: 從檢傷台到急救區，每一分鐘都在排序
tagline.en: From triage to resus, every minute is a sorting problem

desc.zh: 同時看四個病人、接一通救護車電話、回答一個家屬。你排序、你決定、你交班。
desc.en: Four patients at once, one ambulance call, one relative's question. You sort, you decide, you hand over.

desc.zh: 急診的第一道門。誰先看、誰可以等，你三十秒內決定。安靜的病人最需要你。
desc.en: The first door of the department. Who goes first and who can wait: you decide in thirty seconds. The quiet patients need you most.

about.zh: 永遠很冷靜，手上永遠有一個沒吃完的三明治。口頭禪：「最壞的可能是什麼？」
about.en: Always calm, always holding a sandwich she never finishes. Catchphrase: 'What is the worst thing this could be?'

about.zh: 急救區是她的。病人還沒進門，床、監視器、急救車已經就位。
about.en: Resus is hers. Before the patient is through the door the bed, monitor and crash cart are ready.

about.zh: 八十二歲，從安養院送來。不喊痛、不吵鬧，只是「比平常安靜」。這是最危險的一種安靜。
about.en: Eighty-two, sent in from a care home. Not complaining, not restless, just 'quieter than usual'. The most dangerous kind of quiet.

about.zh: 五十二歲貨車司機，胸口悶了二十分鐘，在候診區就不痛了。現在只想回去開車。
about.en: Fifty-two, lorry driver, twenty minutes of chest tightness that eased in the waiting room. Now he just wants to get back on the road.

about.zh: 六十八歲，早餐時太太發現他講話含糊、右手拿不住筷子。救護車十分鐘後到。
about.en: Sixty-eight. At breakfast his wife noticed slurred speech and chopsticks slipping from his right hand. Ambulance ten minutes out.

about.zh: 二十四歲，午餐吃了朋友帶的點心，嘴唇發麻、起疹子、呼吸有聲音。她說「應該沒事吧」。
about.en: Twenty-four. Ate a friend's home-made snack at lunch; tingling lips, a rash, noisy breathing. She says 'it is probably nothing'.

about.zh: 到院前通報一句話講完：年齡、主訴、生命徵象、預計到達。
about.en: Pre-hospital notification in one breath: age, complaint, vitals, ETA.

about.zh: 照顧林阿嬤三年。她說「比平常安靜」的時候，是在告訴你一件很重要的事。
about.en: Has looked after Grandma Lin for three years. When she says 'quieter than usual' she is telling you something important.

plain.zh: 把每一位到急診的人依嚴重程度分級，決定誰先看。不是先到先看。
plain.en: Sorting everyone who arrives by how sick they are, to decide who is seen first. Not first come, first served.

plain.zh: 身體對感染的反應失控，開始傷害自己的器官。老人常常不發高燒，只是變安靜、變迷糊。
plain.en: The body's response to infection running out of control and damaging its own organs. The elderly often have no high fever, just quietness and confusion.

plain.zh: 組織缺氧時產生的物質。抽血看乳酸，是看器官有沒有在「喘不過氣」。
plain.en: A substance produced when tissues lack oxygen. A blood lactate shows whether the organs are 'suffocating'.

plain.zh: 抽血放進培養瓶，讓細菌長出來。要在抗生素之前抽，否則長不出來。
plain.en: Blood placed in culture bottles so bacteria can grow. Taken before antibiotics, or nothing grows.

plain.zh: 十個電極、十二個角度看心臟的電活動。胸痛病人十分鐘內要有一張。
plain.en: Ten electrodes, twelve views of the heart's electrical activity. Every chest-pain patient needs one within ten minutes.

plain.zh: 心肌受傷時漏到血液裡的蛋白質。要抽兩次比較變化，一次正常不代表沒事。
plain.en: A protein that leaks into the blood when heart muscle is injured. Measured twice to see the trend; one normal value does not clear anyone.

plain.zh: 病人最後一次被看到完全正常的時間。中風治療的時鐘從那一刻開始算，不是從發現的時候。
plain.en: The last time the patient was seen completely normal. The stroke clock starts there, not when the symptoms were noticed.

plain.zh: 神經科、放射科、檢驗和急診一起啟動的流程：CT 優先、血糖先測、時間一直算。
plain.en: Neurology, radiology, the lab and the ED activated together: CT first, glucose checked, the clock always running.

plain.zh: 嚴重的全身過敏反應：皮膚、呼吸道、循環同時出事。第一線治療是肌肉注射腎上腺素。
plain.en: A severe whole-body allergic reaction hitting skin, airway and circulation at once. First-line treatment is intramuscular adrenaline.

plain.zh: 過敏性休克好了幾小時後再發作一次。所以治療後不能馬上回家。
plain.en: Anaphylaxis that comes back hours after it settled. The reason nobody goes home straight after treatment.

plain.zh: 用手掌根在胸骨下半段用力、快速、規律地壓，讓血液繼續流動。
plain.en: Pressing hard, fast and regularly with the heel of the hand on the lower half of the breastbone to keep blood moving.

plain.zh: 創傷病人的四個超音波切面，幾十秒內找肚子和心臟周圍有沒有出血。
plain.en: Four ultrasound windows in a trauma patient, finding blood around the abdominal organs and the heart within seconds.

plain.zh: 救護車在路上先打電話，讓急診在病人到達前準備好床、人和設備。
plain.en: The ambulance phoning ahead so the department has bed, people and equipment ready before arrival.

plain.zh: 打電話或交班的順序：我是誰、情況、背景、評估、建議。
plain.en: The order for a call or a handover: identify, situation, background, assessment, recommendation.

text.zh: 一台血壓計、一支體溫計、一支血氧儀、一個會問「為什麼今天來」的人。
text.en: A sphygmomanometer, a thermometer, an oximeter, and someone who asks 'why today?'

text.zh: 十個電極貼對位置，十二個角度才正確。V1 到 V6 的位置是基本功。
text.en: Ten electrodes in the right places give twelve correct views. V1 to V6 placement is the fundamental skill.

text.zh: 每一層抽屜放什麼都固定。去顫器在上面，甦醒球掛側邊。
text.en: Every drawer is fixed. Defibrillator on top, bag-valve mask on the side.

text.zh: 急診醫師自己拿探頭。FAST、肺、心臟，答一個是非題，不是寫報告。
text.en: The emergency doctor holds the probe. FAST, lung, heart: answering a yes-or-no question, not writing a report.

text.zh: 兩套、兩個部位、抗生素之前。瓶身上的時間是你寫的。
text.en: Two sets, two sites, before antibiotics. The time on the bottle is in your handwriting.

text.zh: 沒有 ST 上升。但「沒有」只是開始，不是結束。
text.en: No ST elevation. But 'no' is the beginning, not the end.

name.en: What is the worst thing this could be

text.zh: 急診的思考順序：先排除會死的，再找最可能的。
text.en: The order of thinking in the ED: rule out what kills first, then find what is most likely.

lines.zh: 候診區十二個人，急救區一床。交班板上最新的一行：安養院送來的阿嬤，發燒，剛到。
lines.en: Twelve in the waiting room, one in resus. The newest line on the board: grandmother from a care home, fever, just arrived.

lines.zh: 早。夜班說候診區那位胸痛的大哥不痛了，吵著要走。阿嬤在檢傷台。
lines.en: Morning. Night shift says the chest-pain gentleman in the waiting room is pain-free and wants to leave. Grandma is at triage.

lines.zh: 檢傷分類：阿嬤先，然後胸痛。胸痛的不能走。
lines.en: Triage order: Grandma first, then the chest pain. The chest pain does not leave.

lines.zh: 早。安養院送來的阿嬤，只是發燒。最壞的可能是什麼？
lines.en: Morning. The care-home grandmother: just a fever. What is the worst thing this could be?

lines.zh: 敗血症。老人家常常不喊痛，只是變安靜。
lines.en: Sepsis. The elderly often do not complain; they just go quiet.

lines.zh: 對。那就用那個標準去看她。三明治我放這裡。
lines.en: Right. Then look at her with that standard. I am leaving my sandwich here.

note.zh: 林阿嬤進急救區，敗血症流程啟動
note.en: Grandma Lin to resus; sepsis pathway started

lines.zh: 我沒事……我只是想睡。
lines.en: I am fine... I just want to sleep.

lines.zh: 安養院的轉介單寫著：比平常安靜、吃得少、今天早上尿很少。
lines.en: The care-home note reads: quieter than usual, eating less, very little urine this morning.

lines.zh: 初步線索。一個一個收。
lines.en: First clues. Collect them one by one.

lines.zh: 體溫高、心跳快、血壓偏低、呼吸稍快。她對時間和地點的回答都不對。
lines.en: Temperature up, pulse fast, pressure on the low side, breathing a little quick. She gets the date and the place wrong.

options.zh: 升級檢傷、進急救區、培養後依醫囑抗生素、乳酸、輸液
options.en: Upgrade triage, to resus, cultures then antibiotics per protocol, lactate, fluids

why.zh: 敗血症的時鐘已經在走。先培養再抗生素，乳酸看器官灌流，輸液依醫囑。
why.en: The sepsis clock is running. Cultures before antibiotics, lactate for perfusion, fluids per protocol.

options.zh: 給退燒藥，回候診區等抽血
options.en: Antipyretic and back to the waiting room for bloods

why.zh: 退燒會讓數字好看，不會讓器官好過。她不能回候診區。
why.en: Lowering the temperature makes the numbers look better, not the organs. She does not go back to the waiting room.

options.zh: 先照胸部 X 光找感染源
options.en: Chest X-ray first to find the source

why.zh: 找感染源重要，但不能排在培養、抗生素和輸液前面。
why.en: Finding the source matters, but not before cultures, antibiotics and fluids.

post.zh: 急救區二床，監視器上了。

lines.zh: 血液培養兩套、兩個部位，時間寫在瓶身上。然後才是抗生素。
lines.en: Blood culture: two sets, two sites, the time on each bottle. Only then the antibiotic.

lines.zh: 培養送了，乳酸抽了。抗生素依醫囑現在給。
lines.en: Cultures sent, lactate drawn. Antibiotic going in now per the order.

lines.zh: 安靜、迷糊、尿少、乳酸高。感染源你猜哪裡？
lines.en: Quiet, confused, little urine, high lactate. Where is the source, do you think?

lines.zh: 泌尿道最可能，但肺和皮膚都要看。她背上有沒有壓瘡，我去翻。
lines.en: Urinary most likely, but lungs and skin need checking. I will turn her and look for pressure sores.

lines.zh: 好。阿嬤的培養瓶上的時間，是你今天寫過最重要的字。
lines.en: Good. The time on her culture bottles is the most important thing you will write today.

note.zh: 阿強的心電圖與去向決定

lines.zh: 醫師，我真的不痛了。車還停在路邊，我要去開。
lines.en: Doctor, honestly, the pain is gone. My lorry is parked on the street; I need to move it.

lines.zh: 阿強，不痛了是好事，但不痛不等於沒事。先給我十分鐘做一張心電圖。
lines.en: Mr Chiang, pain-free is good, but it is not the same as fine. Give me ten minutes for an ECG.

lines.zh: 你把阿強的檢傷等級往上調，從候診區移到有監視器的床，並在單子上寫下心電圖的十分鐘期限。
lines.en: You upgrade Mr Chiang's triage category, move him from the waiting room to a monitored bed, and write the ten-minute ECG deadline on his sheet.

lines.zh: 胸痛不痛了的人最會溜走。你盯著他。
lines.en: The ones whose chest pain has stopped are the ones who slip away. Keep an eye on him.

lines.zh: 十二導程心電圖，胸前導程你來貼。貼錯位置，整張圖都錯。
lines.en: 12-lead ECG; you place the chest leads. Wrong positions, wrong tracing.

post.zh: 沒有 ST 上升。T 波有一點平。
post.en: No ST elevation. The T waves are a little flat.

post.zh: 「沒有 ST 上升」是開始，不是結束。
post.en: 'No ST elevation' is the start, not the finish.

guide.zh: 胸部 X 光：找什麼？

lines.zh: 胸痛病人的胸部影像，你在找哪些會死人的非心肌梗塞原因？
lines.en: On a chest-pain patient's chest imaging, which non-infarct killers are you looking for?

question.zh: 胸痛病人的胸部影像，要排除哪些致命的非 ACS 原因？
question.en: On chest imaging for chest pain, which lethal non-ACS causes must be excluded?

answer.zh: 主動脈剝離（縱膈變寬）、氣胸、食道破裂（縱膈氣體）、大量肋膜積液或肺炎。先排除會死的。
answer.en: Aortic dissection (widened mediastinum), pneumothorax, oesophageal rupture (mediastinal air), large effusion or pneumonia. Rule out the killers first.

lines.zh: 心電圖正常了吧？我可以走了吧？
lines.en: ECG normal, right? Can I go now?

q.zh: 第一次肌鈣蛋白正常、心電圖無 ST 上升。你怎麼做？
q.en: First troponin normal, no ST elevation on the ECG. What now?

options.zh: 留觀，照流程抽第二次肌鈣蛋白再決定
options.en: Keep him; second troponin per the pathway, then decide

why.zh: 一次正常的肌鈣蛋白不能排除。看變化，不看單點。
why.en: One normal troponin excludes nothing. The trend decides, not a single value.

options.zh: 心電圖正常，讓他走，門診追蹤
options.en: Normal ECG, let him go, clinic follow-up

why.zh: 他會在下午回來。而且是用救護車。
why.en: He will be back this afternoon. By ambulance.

why.zh: 沒有 ST 上升、血流動力穩定，還沒到那一步。先完成風險分層。
why.en: No ST elevation and he is stable; not yet. Finish the risk stratification first.

note.zh: 吳先生的中風流程啟動

sub.zh: 六十八歲男性，FAST 陽性，十分鐘到
sub.en: Sixty-eight-year-old man, FAST positive, ten minutes

lines.zh: 急診嗎？六十八歲男性，早餐時口齒不清、右手無力。太太說七點半還正常。血糖正常，十分鐘到。
lines.en: ED? Sixty-eight-year-old man, slurred speech and right-arm weakness at breakfast. Wife says normal at half past seven. Glucose normal, ten minutes out.

lines.zh: 收到。最後正常時間七點半。我啟動中風小組，CT 先空出來。
lines.en: Received. Last known well half past seven. Activating the stroke team; CT being cleared now.

lines.zh: 他進門之後的順序，你排。每一分鐘都是腦細胞。
lines.en: Put the steps after he comes through the door in order. Every minute is brain.

q.zh: 中風病人到院後的順序？
q.en: Order the steps when a stroke patient arrives.

steps.zh: 確認最後正常時間與血糖
steps.en: Confirm last known well and glucose

steps.zh: 與神經科決定治療並交班
steps.en: Decide treatment with neurology; hand over

lines.zh: ……我、我講話怪怪的。
lines.en: ...My, my words are strange.

lines.zh: 吳先生，我聽得懂。我們現在直接去照電腦斷層，太太在後面跟著。
lines.en: Mr Wu, I understand you. We are going straight to the CT scanner; your wife is right behind.

lines.zh: 從門口到 CT，走廊上沒有人停下來。羅主治的三明治還在桌上。
lines.en: From the door to CT, nobody in the corridor stops. Dr Lo's sandwich is still on the desk.

lines.zh: CT 沒有出血。你拿出禁忌症清單，一項一項問太太：近期手術、出血、抗凝血劑、血壓。
lines.en: CT shows no bleeding. You take out the contraindication list and go through it with his wife: recent surgery, bleeding, anticoagulants, blood pressure.

lines.zh: 神經科嗎？最後正常時間七點半，CT 無出血，禁忌症核對完成。你們來決定溶栓。
lines.en: Neurology? Last known well half past seven, CT without bleeding, contraindications checked. Thrombolysis is your call.

note.zh: 候診區急救與過敏性休克處理完成

guide.en: Someone has collapsed in the waiting room!

lines.zh: 候診區有人倒下！沒有反應、沒有呼吸！
lines.en: Collapse in the waiting room! Unresponsive, not breathing!

lines.zh: 是一位來探病的中年男子。你跪下去開始胸外按壓，手掌根放在胸骨下半段。
lines.en: A middle-aged visitor. You drop to your knees and start chest compressions, heel of the hand on the lower half of the breastbone.

post.zh: 急救車到了，電極貼上。幾個循環後，他的脈搏回來了，開始咳嗽。
post.en: The crash cart arrives, pads go on. A few cycles later his pulse returns and he starts to cough.

post.zh: 深度對、節奏對、中斷很短。推進急救區，我接手。
post.en: Depth right, rate right, short pauses. Into resus; I have him.

lines.zh: 我應該沒事吧？就是嘴唇麻麻的，身上癢，呼吸有一點點聲音。
lines.en: It is probably nothing, right? Just tingly lips, itchy skin, and my breathing is a little noisy.

lines.zh: 皮膚、呼吸道，兩個系統同時出事。小晴，這叫過敏性休克，我們要現在處理。
lines.en: Skin and airway, two systems at once. Hsiao-Ching, this is anaphylaxis and we treat it now.

lines.zh: 她說頭暈。監視器上血壓掉了，心跳快，聲音越來越啞。
lines.en: She says she feels faint. The pressure on the monitor drops, pulse racing, her voice getting hoarser.

options.zh: 依醫囑肌肉注射腎上腺素、平躺抬腿、氧氣、叫人
options.en: Intramuscular adrenaline per protocol, flat with legs up, oxygen, call for help

why.zh: 過敏性休克的第一線是肌肉注射腎上腺素，不是抗組織胺。平躺抬腿，不要讓她坐起來。
why.en: First line in anaphylaxis is intramuscular adrenaline, not an antihistamine. Flat with legs raised; do not let her sit up.

options.zh: 先給抗組織胺觀察看看

why.zh: 抗組織胺治皮膚癢，救不了血壓和氣道。
why.en: Antihistamines help the itch; they do not rescue the pressure or the airway.

options.zh: 讓她坐起來比較好呼吸
options.en: Sit her up to help her breathe

why.zh: 血壓正在掉的人坐起來可能心跳停止。平躺。
why.en: Sitting up a patient whose pressure is falling can stop the heart. Flat.

post.zh: ……聲音回來了。我可以回家了嗎？
post.en: ...My voice is back. Can I go home?

post.zh: 還不行。雙相反應可能幾小時後再來一次。今天在這裡留觀。
post.en: Not yet. A biphasic reaction can return hours later. You stay with us today.

note.zh: 阿強的第二次肌鈣蛋白與去向
note.en: Mr Chiang's second troponin and disposition

lines.zh: 救護車推進來的是阿強。胸痛又來了，這次沒有停。
lines.en: The ambulance brings in Mr Chiang. The chest pain is back, and this time it has not stopped.

lines.zh: 醫師……我開到一半又痛了。
lines.en: Doctor... it came back halfway through my run.

lines.zh: 早上那一次正常的肌鈣蛋白，現在你知道它的意思了。
lines.en: That one normal troponin this morning: now you know what it meant.

guide.zh: 第二次肌鈣蛋白回來了

lines.zh: 阿強還在留觀區，第二次肌鈣蛋白回來了：比第一次高。
lines.en: Mr Chiang is still in observation. The second troponin is back: higher than the first.

lines.zh: 所以我早上不能走是對的？
lines.en: So you were right not to let me go this morning?

lines.zh: 對。變化才是答案。
lines.en: Yes. The trend was the answer.

sub.zh: 阿強第二次肌鈣蛋白結果已出
sub.en: Mr Chiang: second troponin result is out

lines.zh: 心電圖、兩次肌鈣蛋白、症狀、危險因子。把它們放在一起，然後打給心臟科。
lines.en: ECG, two troponins, symptoms, risk factors. Put them together, then call cardiology.

post.zh: 心臟科嗎？我用 ISBAR 交班：五十二歲男性，胸痛，肌鈣蛋白上升……
post.en: Cardiology? ISBAR handover: fifty-two-year-old man, chest pain, rising troponin...

note.en: Handed over to the night team

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 林阿嬤：敗血症，泌尿道來源，培養已送，抗生素已給，乳酸追蹤中。
lines.en: Grandma Lin: sepsis, urinary source, cultures sent, antibiotics given, lactate being tracked.

lines.zh: 吳先生：中風，已溶栓，神經科收。小晴：過敏性休克，留觀雙相反應。阿強：心臟科收。
lines.en: Mr Wu: stroke, thrombolysed, admitted under neurology. Hsiao-Ching: anaphylaxis, observing for a biphasic reaction. Mr Chiang: admitted under cardiology.

lines.zh: 候診區那位先生，加護病房說他醒了，在問是誰壓的。
lines.en: The waiting-room gentleman: ICU says he is awake and asking who did the compressions.

lines.zh: 今天最安靜的病人是誰？
lines.en: Who was the quietest patient today?

lines.zh: 林阿嬤。
lines.en: Grandma Lin.

lines.zh: 對。急診最難的不是最吵的病人，是最安靜的。你今天聽見了。
lines.en: Yes. The hardest patient in the ED is never the loudest; it is the quietest. Today you heard her.

lines.zh: 三明治我還是沒吃完。回家吧。
lines.en: I still did not finish the sandwich. Go home.

sub.zh: 機車騎士，腹部撞擊，五分鐘到

lines.zh: 急診嗎？二十多歲機車騎士，肚子撞到把手，心跳快、血壓偏低，意識清楚。五分鐘到。
lines.en: ED? Motorcyclist in his twenties, abdomen into the handlebar, fast pulse, low-ish pressure, alert. Five minutes.

lines.zh: 收到。創傷區準備，超音波機推到床邊，血庫先知道。
lines.en: Received. Trauma bay ready, ultrasound to the bedside, blood bank informed.

lines.zh: 病人到了。探頭在你手上，FAST 超音波，四個切面。
lines.en: Patient is here. The probe is in your hand: FAST scan, four windows.

post.zh: 右上腹有游離液體。外科，現在。
post.en: Free fluid in the right upper quadrant. Surgery, now.

post.zh: 外科在路上，血已經到了。
post.en: Surgery is on the way; the blood is here.

guide.en: The last line of the night

lines.zh: 外科把他推進手術室。你在交班板寫下時間，然後發現羅主治的三明治不見了。
lines.en: Surgery wheels him to theatre. You write the time on the board and notice Dr Lo's sandwich has finally gone.

lines.zh: （訊息）阿嬌說 FAST 做得很快，叫外科叫得更快。這就是急診。晚安。
lines.en: (message) A-Chiao says the FAST was quick and the call to surgery quicker. That is emergency medicine. Good night.

sub.zh: 四個病人、一次按壓、一個沒吃完的三明治
sub.en: Four patients, one round of compressions, one unfinished sandwich
